notes:
**You could not tell the simulated market from the real one.** The home screen had the right words and then lost them: with no broker connected you got a full card explaining the prices are simulated - and a button marked "Practice on simulation" that folded it into a one-line strip, forever. That strip is the thing everybody ignored, and people were left believing they were watching the real market for weeks.

The card does not fold any more. **"No broker connected"** as a heading, one line on what to do, a full-width **Connect your broker** button - and the practice note demoted to small grey text underneath, because that is what is happening, not what to do. It removes itself the moment a broker is linked, which is the only dismissal a statement of fact gets.

A broker that IS linked with practice deliberately switched on still gets the small line, because that one is your own choice.
